title: Find a common multiple
prompt: Find a common multiple of {x} and {y}.

recall.name: Know the LCM
recall.idea: Recognize the least common multiple directly.

list_multiples.name: List multiples
list_multiples.idea: Count up by {x} until you reach a number {y} divides.

steps.say: List multiples of {x} until {y} divides one

product.name: Multiply them
product.best_when: The numbers share no factors (then it's also the least).
product.watch_out: When they share a factor, this isn't the least common multiple, so later numbers are bigger and need simplifying.

gcf_formula.name: Use the GCF
gcf_formula.best_when: Large numbers whose GCF you can find.

steps.say: Divide one number by the GCF
